description: Diagram vectors (D-247): the cases both implementations run. Each has the data, the subject whose palette its roles come from, the verdict of config/banco/schemas/diagram.json ('schema': valid|invalid) and, for data the schema accepts, the semantic verdict of Lessons::Diagrams (R1): 'ok', or the code and the JSON pointer 'path' (relative to the diagram, one finding at least). Ruby refuses every vector that is invalid in either column; app/javascript/lesson/diagrams layout() must return { error } for the same vectors (it never throws) and a Scene for the others (R2). 'note' says what the case proves.
